title: ChatGPT Enterprise Now Available on AWS Marketplace
summary: OpenAI listed ChatGPT Enterprise on AWS Marketplace November 9, 2026. Customers can now procure through AWS billing and apply spend to commitments.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- OpenAI launched ChatGPT Enterprise on AWS Marketplace November 9, 2026, letting customers procure through existing AWS billing.
- The listing includes ChatGPT for Healthcare and Financial Services with feature parity to direct OpenAI purchases.
- Pricing remains undisclosed, and commitment credit eligibility requires conversations with OpenAI or AWS account teams.


OpenAI listed ChatGPT Enterprise on AWS Marketplace on November 9, 2026, giving enterprise customers a new procurement path that routes billing through their existing AWS accounts. The listing covers ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT for Healthcare, and ChatGPT for Financial Services, with eligible spend counting toward AWS commitments.


## Officially launched on November 9, 2026


The AWS Marketplace listing went live November 9, 2026, marking OpenAI's first major cloud marketplace integration for its enterprise product line. Matt Yanchyshyn, VP AWS Marketplace and Partner Services, said enterprises want to put AI to work across teams without adding new procurement layers. The AWS route consolidates software spend governance and accelerates the path from evaluation to full rollout.


## Feature parity with direct OpenAI purchases


OpenAI emphasizes that AWS customers receive the same models, features, and functionality available through direct purchase, with new capabilities released simultaneously across both channels. The listing is not a separate AWS-specific build. Instead, it functions as an alternative invoice route while preserving the full ChatGPT Enterprise experience. This includes:


- Access to the latest GPT models with enterprise-grade security and admin controls
- Industry-specific SKUs for healthcare and financial services workflows
- The same feature cadence and model updates as direct customers


## Pricing and eligibility details


OpenAI has not disclosed public pricing for the AWS Marketplace listing. Both pricing and eligibility for AWS commitment credit application are gated behind account-team conversations. Organizations interested in the healthcare or financial services SKUs must also route inquiries through OpenAI or AWS sales channels. The commitment credit structure lets buyers apply ChatGPT Enterprise spend against their existing AWS Enterprise Discount Program or Private Pricing Agreement commitments, reducing the perceived cost of AI tooling for teams already invested in AWS infrastructure.


## Context within OpenAI's commercial expansion


The AWS Marketplace launch arrives during a dense period of commercial activity for OpenAI. Over the past ninety days, the company has expanded enterprise distribution channels, introduced vertical-specific product tiers, and deepened integration partnerships across cloud platforms. The AWS listing fits a broader pattern of embedding ChatGPT Enterprise into the procurement workflows enterprises already use, lowering the friction for IT and finance teams evaluating AI adoption.


## What this means


OpenAI's AWS Marketplace listing reduces procurement complexity for enterprise buyers who prefer consolidated software spend management. By enabling AWS commitment credit application, OpenAI aligns ChatGPT Enterprise with the budget mechanics large organizations already navigate. The feature parity guarantee ensures AWS customers do not sacrifice capability for convenience, while the vertical SKUs signal OpenAI's continued focus on regulated industries where procurement and compliance workflows are tightly controlled.
